# Lingroo

Lingroo is a German B2/C1 exam-oriented practice web app and PWA.

Main product:
- https://www.lingroo.de/

Landing and SEO hub:
- https://www.lingroo.app/
- https://www.lingroo.app/de/
- https://www.lingroo.app/de/telc-c1-hochschule/
- https://www.lingroo.app/de/c1-schreiben-feedback/
- https://www.lingroo.app/de/c1-wortschatz-training/

Lingroo helps learners practise short daily tasks for German B2/C1: vocabulary, gap exercises, C1 formulation upgrades, writing feedback, reading/listening tasks and focused exam-mode sessions.

Lingroo is independent and not affiliated with telc, Goethe-Institut or TestDaF.
